name: Kudou Sayaka
source:
Masaharu's beloved girlfriend, whom he has been dating since their university days.

She currently works as a Japanese language and literature teacher at the private Tatsunomiya Academy.

She is very popular among the students, who regard her as a beautiful and kind teacher. After school, she also serves as the faculty advisor for the drama club, making use of the experience she gained during her own student days.

Her father died in an accident when she was in middle school, after which she was raised single-handedly by her mother. As a result, she feels deeply grateful to her mother.

When Sayaka reached adulthood, her mother remarried. Although Sayaka was genuinely happy about her mother's remarriage, she never quite got along with her stepfather, and the two have gradually grown somewhat distant.

(Sayaka continues to use her biological father's surname.)

Having attended an all-girls' school and devoted herself to part-time jobs to help support her family, she never had much opportunity to become romantically involved with the opposite sex. She had no experience with men before starting her relationship with the protagonist.

Even after six years, her affection for the protagonist has not diminished. If anything, she feels that their bond has grown even stronger.

She is relatively enthusiastic when it comes to sex, and is the type of person who wants both partners to enjoy themselves and experience mutual pleasure.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11291]the official site[/url]]
